misc.text: #ONEPIECE1190 No wonder why Gaban lost his arm. With a broken sword(and im sure it has a ability like that where Imu can cut anyone without touching them), every top tier would get problems... Imu sword collection became more and more scary... The Will of Marco (マルコの意志) (@TheWillOfMarco) #ONEPIECE1190 Imu's new weapon is called Honebami (骨喰)—literally meaning "Bone-Eater" or "Bone-Devourer." The name comes from 骨 (hone) meaning "bone" and 喰 (bami) meaning "to eat," "devour," "bite," or "consume." This is a homage to the legendary Japanese blade Honebami Tōshirō (骨喰藤四郎). It was forged by the master Japanese swordsmith Awataguchi Tōshirō Yoshimitsu (粟田口藤四郎吉光) during the Kamakura Period. "Honebami Tōshirō" essentially means "Honebami, forged by Tōshirō." According to legend, Honebami was so extraordinarily sharp that merely pointing it at someone could shatter their bones, even before making contact—a mythical tale meant to emphasize its terrifying cutting power. Interestingly, the original Honebami was first forged as a naginata (polearm) before later being shortened into a wakizashi (short sword), while retaining its legendary name throughout history. — https://nitter.net/TheWillOfMarco/status/2084796225057092031#m
